A stated part already short of a minimum breaks it whatever the unstated parts read; otherwise an unstated part leaves it incomplete, and a limit with no stated part reads incomplete. A summed minimum with nothing stated also reads incomplete, never exceeded. Every reader of the judged rollup follows: the reasoning truth of a Constraint, closure_report's margin and the KPP breach.
